# Glassmind

Glassmind is a frosted-glass, semi-transparent interface using the Catppuccin Mocha palette for dark mode and Latte for light. The recorded description says compositor blur produces the full frosted effect while subtle transparency remains without it, and claims a minimal, distraction-free layout with wide plugin compatibility.

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Glassmind"
    author: "m3hransh"
    repo:   "m3hransh/glassmind-obsidian-theme"
    slug:   "glassmind"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/glassmind"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/m3hransh/glassmind-obsidian-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m3hransh/glassmind-obsidian-theme/HEAD/"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a frosted-glass, semi-transparent interface using Catppuccin Mocha (dark) and Latte (light) palettes for clean dark and light modes. Enable compositor blur for the full frosted effect or keep subtle transparency; enjoy a minimal, distraction-free layout with wide plugin compatibility."
}
```
